card.text: K2-72 e was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-72e"
sources.quote: K2-72e (also known by its EPIC designation EPIC 206209135.04), is a confirmed exoplanet, likely rocky, orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf star K2-72, the outermost of four such planets discovered in the system by NASA's Kepler spacecraft on its "Second Light" mission.

introduction.text: It is one of 4 planets known around K2-72. Its orbit and size follow Dressing et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-72e"
sources.quote: It is located about 217.1 light-years (66.56 parsecs, or nearly 2.0538×1015 km) away from Earth in the constellation of Aquarius.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
